body_html:
Thank you for submitting Southern Connecticut State University’s Shaping our Worlds and Exploring Our We(s): WebVR and Computer science Ethics to the Responsible Computer Science Challenge, and for taking the time to submit ideas for integrating ethics into computer science curricula. Unfortunately, we received many high-quality submissions that exceeded what our funding could support, and we will not be moving forward with your application. Please let me know if you would like to receive brief feedback from the review panel that might inform future applications for funding.

We consider all applicants to the Responsible Computer Science Challenge – successful this round or not – as part of our Mozilla network. We hope you feel the same way and we invite you to stay connected and engaged with us.
